description: This file implements the 'Category' controller for the OpenCart admin interface. It manages CRUD operations, listing, form handling, status toggling, deletion, repair, and autocomplete functionality for product categories within the administrative backend.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class for managing product categories in the admin panel, providing methods for listing, editing, creating, enabling, disabling, deleting, repairing, and autocompleting categories.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads category list view page with necessary data such as breadcrumbs, filters, language, store options, and related controllers.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of categories by delegating to getList method, typically used for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares category data with filters, sorting, pagination, and renders the category list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Loads the category add/edit form, populating data if editing an existing category, including SEO URLs, filters, images, and layouts.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or existing category data, including validation of input, SEO URLs, and permissions. Returns JSON response.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected categories by setting their status to active, with permission check.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected categories by setting their status to inactive, with permission check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected categories after permission check.

methods.name: repair
methods.description: Rearranges category hierarchy to repair broken paths or inconsistent structure.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON list of categories matching filter name for autocomplete functionality.
